solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing; the grid proves the blog's enumeration wrong at 11 down, recounted from the answer here

clue.text: A food offered to friend is nice to eat

indicators.note: the food is set beside, as if handed to, the friend, so those letters follow

parts.note: a pal is a friend
table here means the food served, as in a host who keeps a good table

explanation.surface: A dish is handed to a friend, and it turns out to be tasty.
explanation.definitionFit: Something palatable is pleasant to the taste, so agreeable to eat.

clue.text: Intrinsically American, this group of stars

parts.note: per se is Latin for 'in itself', that is intrinsically
US is short for American, as in United States

explanation.surface: Something essentially American is being described as a constellation.
explanation.definitionFit: Perseus is a northern constellation, named after the Greek hero who slew Medusa.

clue.text: Bit of a plague place gets over time

indicators.note: in a down clue the place sits above, over, the time letter

parts.note: a locus is a place or position

explanation.surface: A place suffers from plague over a period of time.
explanation.definitionFit: Locusts arrive in vast swarms, and a single insect is one member of such a biblical plague.

clue.text: Mark fell finally into flowing water

indicators.note: into puts that closing letter inside the word for flowing water

parts.note: the tide is the flow of the sea

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of the word fell

explanation.surface: Someone notes a mark where a person fell into a stream at last.
explanation.definitionFit: A tilde is a diacritic, the wavy sign written over a letter as in Spanish señor.

clue.text: Grumble, not wanting loud buzzer

indicators.note: not wanting says the letter for loud is dropped from the grumble word

parts.note: to beef is to grumble or complain
F is forte, the musical abbreviation for loud

explanation.surface: Someone moans but doesn't want a noisy alarm.
explanation.definitionFit: A bee is an insect famed for its buzzing, so a buzzer in the cryptic sense.

clue.text: Gets rid of examiner, test being botched

indicators.note: something botched is messed up, so these letters are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A school sacks an examiner because a test was bungled.
explanation.definitionFit: To exterminate is to destroy completely, a forceful way of getting rid of something.

clue.text: Urgent message in taxi left half hidden

parts.note: a cab is a taxi

indicators.note: with half of the word left hidden, only its first two letters remain on show

explanation.surface: An urgent note was left in a cab, partly out of sight.
explanation.definitionFit: A cable is a telegram, the old way of sending a pressing message abroad.

clue.text: Pay no attention to lamb left over from roast?

definitions.meaning: to snub or deliberately ignore someone
literally, a joint of lamb served chilled the day after the Sunday roast

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means a deliberate snub, and the literal reading is cooled leftover shoulder of lamb.

clue.text: Like some toast, say, in bed

indicators.note: in puts the word for say inside the word bed

parts.note: taken as written
to utter is to say

explanation.surface: A picture of breakfast in bed, with toast spread ready.
explanation.definitionFit: Toast is often spread with butter, so some toast is described this way.

clue.text: Remember prayer at end of Scripture lesson maybe

indicators.note: at end of puts the prayer after the lesson letters

parts.note: RE is religious education, a school subject that may teach Scripture
a collect is a short prayer in Anglican liturgy

explanation.surface: A pupil recalls the prayer said as a Scripture lesson closes.
explanation.walkthrough: RE (religious education) is a British school subject.
explanation.definitionFit: To recollect is to recall or bring back to mind.

clue.text: Plant covered in plot usually

indicators.note: covered in signals the plant name is concealed within the following words

explanation.surface: A plant is usually grown covered in a garden plot.
explanation.definitionFit: The lotus is an aquatic plant, the sacred water lily of Asia.

clue.text: See errant drunk, one on US's Atlantic coast?

indicators.note: drunk suggests the letters reel about and land in a new order

explanation.surface: Watch out for a wayward drunkard from the American east coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from the eastern seaboard of America is an easterner, hence the question mark for the example.

clue.text: What upsets us — canine creating inconvenience

indicators.note: to upset something is to overturn it, so these letters are tipped into a new order

explanation.surface: A dog's behaviour bothers us and causes trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: A nuisance is an annoyance or inconvenience, something that causes bother.

clue.text: Mostly difficult idiot making trouble

indicators.note: mostly says only most of the word for difficult is kept, losing its final letter

parts.note: hard means difficult
an ass is a fool or idiot

explanation.surface: A rather awkward fool is causing problems.
explanation.definitionFit: To harass is to pester or annoy persistently, a verb sense of trouble.

clue.text: Island volunteers arrive at island's capital

parts.note: the TA, Territorial Army, was Britain's volunteer reserve force
to hit a place is to arrive at it

indicators.note: capital means the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Volunteers reach the chief city of an island.
explanation.walkthrough: The TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's part-time volunteer reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: Tahiti is the largest island of French Polynesia in the South Pacific.

clue.text: A person renouncing booze — almost futile endeavour

parts.note: TT means teetotal, a teetotaller abstaining from alcohol

indicators.note: almost says the word for futile loses its last letter

parts.note: empty can mean futile, as in empty threats

explanation.surface: A man giving up drink makes an almost hopeless effort.
explanation.definitionFit: An attempt is a try or effort, and endeavour is a formal word for one.

clue.text: Spoil narrow gorge

definitions.meaning: verb sense: to sully, corrupt or desecrate
noun sense: a steep narrow pass through which troops must file

explanation.definitionFit: One word serves as both a verb meaning to pollute and a noun for a narrow mountain pass.

clue.text: Suffered in a French river

parts.note: un is French for a
the Derwent is a river in England, one of several of that name

explanation.surface: Someone endured hardship on a river in France.
explanation.walkthrough: The Derwent is an English river (several bear the name, in Derbyshire, Cumbria and Yorkshire).
explanation.definitionFit: To undergo is to experience or endure, so went through, suffered.

clue.text: Little marsupial? Gosh, it's big!

parts.note: roo is a familiar short form for a kangaroo, and Roo is the little one in Winnie-the-Pooh
my, as in 'my!', is an exclamation like gosh

explanation.surface: Someone sees a small kangaroo and exclaims at how large it is.
explanation.definitionFit: Roomy means spacious, so something roomy is big inside.

clue.text: Painter formerly concealing name

indicators.note: concealing means the word for formerly wraps around the name letter

parts.note: erst is an old word for formerly, as in erstwhile

explanation.surface: An artist once hid his real name.
explanation.definitionFit: Max Ernst was a German-born Surrealist and Dada painter.

clue.text: In a belief in God, detect tyranny

indicators.note: In places the word for detect inside the word for a belief in God

parts.note: deism is belief in a creator God without revealed religion
to spot is to detect

explanation.surface: Someone spots tyranny lurking within a religious faith.
explanation.definitionFit: Despotism is absolute rule by one person, essentially tyranny.

clue.text: Dad's served up juice

indicators.note: in a down clue, served up means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: pa's means dad's

explanation.surface: Father has poured out some juice.
explanation.definitionFit: Sap is the vital fluid of plants, a natural juice.

clue.text: Prioress denied port and jam

indicators.note: denied means the port is withheld from the religious superior's title

parts.note: Rio, short for Rio de Janeiro, is a Brazilian port

explanation.surface: A nun is refused port wine and jam.
explanation.definitionFit: A press is a crush of people, as is a jam; both also mean to squeeze.

clue.text: May repent awfully making this recompense

indicators.note: awfully here means badly done, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone may regret badly, and so offers compensation.
explanation.definitionFit: A repayment is money given back, a form of compensation.
